method: Read JUDGE_PROMPT.md and CHECKLIST.md, verified the candidate SHA256, then opened every one of the 30 assigned regular JPG files individually at original detail with view_image: all 3 watch sheets, the 30-tile negative-scan sheet, and strip plus pair images 000 through 012. Checked all checklist items, the locked transition facts, and one-label placement on every Dan picture. No sampling was used. || Read JUDGE_PROMPT.md and CHECKLIST.md, verified the candidate SHA256, then opened every regular pair_NNN and strip_NNN JPG for NNN 013 through 025 individually at original detail. Scored each boundary against all 11 checklist items and the locked transition and photo-label rules. No sampling was used. || Verified the candidate SHA256, then opened every regular JPG named strip_NNN and pair_NNN for NNN 026 through 038 individually at original detail. Judged all five consecutive boundary frames in each strip and the -1|0 frames in each pair against all 11 checklist items and the locked transition and label facts. No sampling was used.
